text: Documentation inventories a KB MCP server: 94 tools total, split into knowledge-graph (11), experience/meditation lifecycle (26), and SOUL persona (20). Architecture principle: writes go through the HTTP API, mutating all five storage layers atomically; reads use direct file access with zero backend load on the hot search path; MCP-first invocation is mandated. Storage is five-layer: L1 Markdown content plus images, L2 global `.tree-fs.json` file-tree index, L3 per-KB `.knowledge-base.yml` registry, L4 1024-dim ChromaDB/BGE-M3 embeddings, L5 Neo4j graph at `bolt://127.0.0.1:7687`. Four invariants: L3 documents exist on disk and in L2; `vector_index.collection` points to the parent KB (sub-KB searches return 0); `graph_doc_id` matches the Neo4j node; disk, `.tree-fs.json`, and `.knowledge-base.yml` stay three-way consistent (verified by V1–V9).
